rationale: C18 is a concrete, material drafting template for the child. Both implement the same agreement country-by-country and share nearly identical recitals concerning the Agreement, statutory authority, removal from GSP/CBERA/CBTPA, and section 604 authority. Their operative provisions use the same machinery: modify the HTS through incorporation by reference of a country-specific USITC publication, prescribe entry/warehouse effective dates, and supersede inconsistent prior directives. The child adapts C18 from Honduras and Nicaragua to Guatemala while omitting the separate staged-duty provision. C21 is another strong same-agreement template, while C02 supplies a closely parallel but less specific free-trade-agreement form.

shared_material.child_excerpt: each Agreement country is to be removed from the enumeration of designated beneficiary developing countries eligible for the benefits of the Generalized System of Preferences (GSP) on the date the Agreement enters into force with respect to that country
shared_material.parent_excerpt: each Agreement country is to be removed from the enumeration of designated beneficiary developing countries eligible for the benefits of the Generalized System of Preferences (GSP) on the date the Agreement enters into force with respect to that country
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive verbatim recital within the same CAFTA-DR implementation framework.

shared_material.child_excerpt: to provide generally for the preferential tariff treatment being accorded under the Agreement to Guatemala ... to reflect the removal of Guatemala ... for purposes of the GSP ... CBERA and the CBTPA ... the HTS is modified as set forth in the Annex of Publication 3861 ... which is incorporated by reference into this proclamation
shared_material.parent_excerpt: to provide generally for the preferential tariff treatment being accorded under the Agreement to Honduras and Nicaragua ... to reflect the removal of Honduras and Nicaragua ... for purposes of the GSP ... CBERA and the CBTPA ... the HTS is modified as set forth in Annex I of Publication 3845 ... which is incorporated by reference into this proclamation
shared_material.explanation: The child closely adapts C18's central operative sentence, changing the participating country and USITC publication while retaining its sequence, purposes, and incorporation mechanism.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The amendments to the HTS made by paragraph (1) ... shall be effective with respect to goods entered, or withdrawn from warehouse for consumption, on or after the relevant dates indicated in the Annex to Publication 3861
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The amendments to the HTS made by paragraphs (1) and (2) ... shall be effective with respect to goods entered, or withdrawn from warehouse for consumption, on or after the relevant dates indicated in Annex I and Annex II to Publication 3845
shared_material.explanation: The effective-date provision is materially parallel and adapted to the child's reduced one-paragraph tariff modification structure.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Any provisions of previous proclamations and Executive Orders that are inconsistent with the actions taken in this proclamation are superseded to the extent of such inconsistency.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Any provisions of previous proclamations and Executive Orders that are inconsistent with the actions taken in this proclamation are superseded to the extent of such inconsistency.
shared_material.explanation: Verbatim closing provision reinforces the broader shared drafting sequence, though this clause alone would be boilerplate.
